summary: Iteration 10: Tested the new username-based auth (admin/guru), login form field changes, and mobile/desktop login logo placement. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass (admin login with username=admin@absenspg.local -> name 'admin', guru login with plain username 'guru' -> name 'Siti Nurhaliza', legacy email 'guru@absenspg.local' correctly rejected 401 'Username atau password salah', username case-insensitive, httpOnly cookie set, bcrypt $2b$ hashes, users collection migrated (no 'email' field, only username_1 unique index), protected endpoints /api/masters,/api/students,/api/schedules,/api/dashboard/stats,/api/settings all 200 with no _id leakage). Frontend: login form now labeled 'Username', type=text, placeholder 'admin atau username guru', request body uses username; guru login via UI works on mobile, legacy email shows inline error; mobile sidebar + logout still work; desktop login layout unchanged (logo in right white panel). FAILED: on mobile viewport (390x844) the school logo + 'SMP PGRI Gandoang' is NOT displayed at all in the green panel (computed display:none) - the requested feature is not working.

minor.issue: No brute-force protection/lockout: 6 consecutive wrong-password attempts all return 401 and the 7th correct attempt still succeeds. No rate limiting or account lockout implemented.
FRONTEND_URL has a hardcoded preview URL fallback in code (line 520). Should read from env only so missing config fails fast.

ui_bugs.issue: MOBILE LOGO MISSING: On 390x844 viewport, .mobile-brand computed display is 'none', so logo + 'SMP PGRI Gandoang' never renders above 'RUANG KERJA GURU'. RCA: in /app/frontend/src/App.css the rule '.mobile-brand{display:none}' on line 8 is declared AFTER the @media(max-width:780px) block on line 7 that sets '.mobile-brand{display:flex}'. Media queries add no specificity, so the later flat rule wins at every viewport. Fix: move the default '.mobile-brand{display:none}' declaration BEFORE the max-width:780px media query (or make the media-query rule more specific, e.g. '.login-visual .mobile-brand{display:flex}').

issues: Green hero panel has a large empty area at the top where the logo was expected; no overlap issue, but branding is absent

action_items: Reorder App.css so '.mobile-brand{display:none}' comes before the @media(max-width:780px) block (or increase media-query rule specificity) so the mobile logo + school name actually renders at the top of the green panel above 'RUANG KERJA GURU'.
Optional: add login rate limiting / lockout after repeated failures.
Optional: remove the hardcoded FRONTEND_URL fallback in the CORS middleware.
critical_code_review_comments: CSS cascade bug: flat rules declared after media queries silently override responsive rules - App.css is a single-line minified-style file which makes such ordering bugs easy to introduce; consider splitting/formatting it.
seed_accounts() migration is idempotent and correctly drops email_1 and creates unique username_1 - verified in DB.

Login is case-insensitive on username (payload.username.strip().lower()) but seeded usernames are already lowercase - fine, but note stored usernames are not normalized on insert for future user-creation endpoints.

Only open issue is the mobile login logo hidden by CSS ordering in App.css. Desktop login layout verified unchanged. Sidebar scroll/logout regression re-verified on mobile.
rca_of_the_issue: The mobile brand block is hidden because '.mobile-brand{display:none}' (App.css line 8) is written after the @media(max-width:780px) rule (line 7) that sets display:flex. Equal specificity + later source order => display:none wins on all viewports, so the logo never appears on mobile. Reproduce: open preview URL at 390x844 and evaluate getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.mobile-brand')).display -> 'none'.
